question: As of March 2022, which of the following has NOT been a theme of the Independence Day celebrations?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Service Before Self__**

__
 
• Satyameva Jayate__

 __
 
• It is a part of a mantra from the Hindu scripture Mundaka Upanishad.
 
• It was adopted as the national motto of India on 26 January 1950.
 
• It is inscribed in the Devanagari script at the base of the Lion Capital of Ashoka and forms an integral part of the Indian National Emblem and inscribed on one side of all Indian currency and national documents.
 
 
 
• Vande Mataram__
 __
 
• It is the National Song of India and was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in his novel Anandmath in 1882.
 
• On 24 January 1950, it was adopted as a national song of India by the Constituent Assembly of India.
 
• 1896 session of the Indian National Congress held at Calcutta is the first political event where the National Song was sung.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nation First Always First** was the theme of the **75th Independence Day **of India in **2022**, Celebrating the milestones achieved by our country. 
 
• **Azadi 70 **Yad Kro Kurbani was the theme of the **70th Independence Day **of India in **2016**.
